messages.content: I want to buy apples, rice, and 12 pack of bottled water from a Walmart near San Jose. Show me the product information and stock availability.

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

But the spec says "The size of the array should be equal to product_list." So we need to provide array of same length. So we can provide pack_size: [0, 0, 12] or [1, 1, 12]. Let's use [0, 0, 12] to indicate no pack size. Or we can use [undefined, undefined, 12] but undefined is not number. So we can use [0, 0, 12]. That should be fine.
